heterogeneity_flagged: LAW MIXES TWO FAILURE FAMILIES. Its distress modes are a mix of DYNAMICAL failures (court backlog/overload = flooding/gating; enforcement collapse and executive overreach = disinhibition; hypertrophied punishment = runaway) and INTEGRITY failures (agency capture, corrupted allegiance, rule-of-law erosion). The dynamical ones are mapped GROUNDED; the integrity one is marked UNMAPPED, not force-fit.

REGULATORY_CAPTURE — UNMAPPED. Its mechanism ('watchdogs into lapdogs', 'co-opted by the industries they are meant to oversee', authored dACC cue 'regulators identify with industry rather than public') is an INTEGRITY / adversarial-capture / corrupted-allegiance failure. The 9 Part XIV classes are all E/I-dynamics archetypes (excitation, inhibition, gating, clearance, synchrony, propagation); none expresses a control node whose allegiance has been captured to serve the adversary. Marked UNMAPPED rather than force-fit. THIS IS THE KEY FINDING: Law carries an integrity/capture archetype that the neuro-substrate taxonomy structurally cannot represent — the direct analog of Finance FRAUD_SCANDAL.

REGULATORY_CAPTURE vs CONSTITUTIONAL_VIOLATION share the SAME canonical cue (vmPFC[Hypo] 'top-down inhibitory brake — brake-fail=rogue'), yet they diverge: CONSTITUTIONAL_VIOLATION = the brake is ABSENT/overridden (executive overreach), a dynamical DISINHIBITION; REGULATORY_CAPTURE = the brake is PRESENT but its allegiance is corrupted to serve the regulated party (capture), an integrity failure with no dynamical analog. Same node cue, different failure family — recorded, not resolved by force-fit.

JUDICIAL_CRISIS and MASS_INCARCERATION — their CANONICAL single-node circuits (THAL alone; PAG alone) are bare non-regulatory nodes that would FAIL the incomplete-circuit test in isolation. The _authored multi-node circuits supply the regulatory partner, so the test passes on _authored. Observation recorded per issue.

INTERNATIONAL_LAW_BREAKDOWN — classed DISINHIBITION_SYNDROME on its dominant cue (great-power unilateralism = actors unrestrained by the brake); its authored primary node AG[Hypo] ('integrative capacity collapses ... fragment into bilateral deals') points at a secondary de-integration / DEAFFERENTATION flavor, plus a legitimacy strand. Divergence recorded, not resolved by guessing.
_meta.honesty_note: Mechanisms, failure-mode classes, parameters, and references below are verbatim-grounded in the source document. Per-node / per-edge Law-specific assignments the document gives no basis for (which edge is which inhibitory motif, which oscillatory band, which neuromodulator, which predictive direction) are NOT guessed here; only the two operations the source document directly supports are performed: (1) classify each authored issue against the Part XIV failure taxonomy where the issue's own text names a matching dynamical mechanism, and (2) run the Part XIV incomplete-circuit test. Where an issue's mechanism is an integrity/capture failure with no dynamical analog, it is marked UNMAPPED.

fractal_critical_mechanisms.name: Excitation/inhibition (E/I) balance
fractal_critical_mechanisms.definition: Inhibition tracks excitation on a millisecond timescale; balance sets gain, dynamic range, timing precision, and stability. Loss of inhibition -> runaway (seizure); excess -> silence.
fractal_critical_mechanisms.design_invariant: Any faithful mapping must have inhibition/brakes that SCALE WITH DRIVE.

fractal_critical_mechanisms.name: Four inhibitory motifs
fractal_critical_mechanisms.definition: feedforward (narrow temporal window / coincidence), feedback/recurrent (self-limiting, gain control, stability), lateral (contrast enhancement, winner-take-all, sparsening), disinhibition (inhibiting an inhibitor = permissive gating/selection).
fractal_critical_mechanisms.design_invariant: All four are reused at every scale; their absence breaks the fractal.

fractal_critical_mechanisms.name: Oscillations & communication-through-coherence
fractal_critical_mechanisms.definition: Rhythms create periodic windows of excitability; groups that oscillate coherently open input/output windows at the same time and communicate; incoherent groups are functionally disconnected. Bands: delta 1-4, theta 4-8, alpha 8-12, beta 13-30, gamma 30-80+ Hz.
fractal_critical_mechanisms.design_invariant: Coherence = a dynamic routing/connection switch. There is an OPTIMAL coupling band; too-strong and too-weak coupling both fail.

fractal_critical_mechanisms.name: Thalamocortical gating
fractal_critical_mechanisms.definition: Thalamus + TRN gate what reaches cortex; tonic (faithful relay) vs burst (detection/alerting) modes under corticothalamic top-down control.
fractal_critical_mechanisms.design_invariant: Gating must occur AT THE RIGHT STAGE - filter too early (before the circuit that needs the signal) and you lose information you cannot recover.

fractal_critical_mechanisms.name: Predictive coding / prediction error
fractal_critical_mechanisms.definition: Hierarchical generative machine: top-down predictions descend, bottom-up prediction ERRORS ascend, only the mismatch propagates upward. Laminar correlate: forward = error, backward = prediction.
fractal_critical_mechanisms.design_invariant: 'Prediction error drives update' must also GENERATE predictions at the mapped scale, not merely react.

fractal_critical_mechanisms.name: Plasticity / learning rules
fractal_critical_mechanisms.definition: Hebbian (correlated -> strengthen); STDP (pre-before-post ~+10 ms -> LTP, post-before-pre -> LTD; dopamine extends LTP window to ~+30 ms); LTP/LTD (NMDA/Ca2+); homeostatic scaling (global normalization keeping drive in range so Hebbian learning does not run away); metaplasticity (threshold for change adapts).
fractal_critical_mechanisms.design_invariant: A stabilizing counter-process (homeostatic scaling) MUST counter positive-feedback Hebbian learning, or the system runs away.

fractal_critical_mechanisms.name: Neuromodulation & gain
fractal_critical_mechanisms.definition: Diffuse systems (DA, NE, 5-HT, ACh) carry no detailed content; they set global regime - gain, signal-to-noise, exploration/exploitation, learning rate, arousal. A small modulatory signal reconfigures the whole network's operating point.
fractal_critical_mechanisms.design_invariant: A small broadcast signal must be able to rescale the whole system's operating point (one-to-many, multiplicative).

fractal_critical_mechanisms.name: Population & attractor dynamics
fractal_critical_mechanisms.definition: Information lives in distributed population activity, not single cells; sparse coding is efficient/separable; attractor dynamics implement stable states and transitions. Over-gating, over-synchrony, or lost inhibition suppress emergence.
fractal_critical_mechanisms.design_invariant: Emergence requires distributed, sparse, inhibition-balanced activity; do not concentrate all state in one node.

fractal_critical_mechanisms.name: Sleep, homeostasis & offline processing
fractal_critical_mechanisms.definition: Sleep down-scales synapses globally while consolidating select memories, and drives glymphatic clearance of waste.
fractal_critical_mechanisms.design_invariant: A mandatory OFFLINE maintenance/reset phase - a system with no downtime accumulates damage.

fractal_critical_mechanisms.name: Signal termination / clearance
fractal_critical_mechanisms.definition: Reuptake, enzymatic degradation, and diffusion bound signal persistence; termination is as important as release and prevents excitotoxic accumulation.
fractal_critical_mechanisms.design_invariant: Clearance/termination must bound signal persistence; a signal that isn't cleared becomes toxic (see failure mode EXCITOTOXICITY).

fractal_critical_mechanisms.name: Refractoriness / dead-time rate limiter
fractal_critical_mechanisms.definition: Absolute refractory period (~1-2 ms) after an action prevents a second action; enforces one-way propagation and caps maximum firing rate.
fractal_critical_mechanisms.design_invariant: A built-in rate limiter / dead-time after action must exist to cap throughput and enforce directionality.

inhibitory_motifs_catalog.definition: Input excites both a target and an interneuron that inhibits the target -> narrow temporal window (coincidence-detection, AND within a time window).
Output feeds back through interneurons -> self-limiting, gain control, stability.
Active units suppress neighbors -> contrast enhancement, winner-take-all, sparsening.
Inhibiting an inhibitor -> permissive gating / selection.

failure_modes.definition: E/I balance failure: runaway recurrent excitation when inhibition is insufficient. Archetypal no-brakes -> runaway.
Excessive drive with failed termination/clearance -> overload -> death of the unit.
A slow wave of depolarization then silence; homeostatic overwhelm.
Thalamocortical/TRN gating breakdown: too little filtering -> flooding, or mis-timed gating -> wrong information passed; gate stuck closed -> starvation.
Losing the inhibitor releases pathological activity (loss of the stop/brake).
Over-coupling (hypersynchrony) or under-coupling; both degrade communication.
Aggregation + failed clearance + network collapse; maintenance failure compounding over time.
Losing input disables not just the lesioned node but distant connected regions. THE NETWORK, NOT THE NODE, IS THE UNIT OF FAILURE; failures propagate across the graph.

A circuit built without its regulatory partner is intrinsically dysfunctional (fear acquisition without extinction; excitation without matched inhibition; feedback without the sensor). THE DIRECT DIAGNOSTIC FOR A BROKEN FRACTAL MAPPING: if the mapping omits the inhibitory/feedback/extinction arm, it is lesioned in the same way a brain is.

issue_failure_class_map._basis: GROUNDED: each mapping uses the Law issue's OWN text (canonical circuit detail and/or authored circuit detail and/or summary, quoted in law_text) plus the document's Part XIV named class. No new class was invented. Where the issue text names a mechanism with no analog among the 9 classes (an integrity/capture failure), it is marked UNMAPPED rather than force-fit.

JUDICIAL_CRISIS.subtype: throughput failure — gate stuck-closed / backlog overload -> starvation
JUDICIAL_CRISIS.law_text: canonical circuit THAL[Hypo]: "gating relay / routing — stuck-closed=starvation"; summary: "Court system overwhelmed or compromised. Case backlogs create justice delays equivalent to justice denial ... The entire legal system depends on functional courts"
JUDICIAL_CRISIS.reasoning: The named mechanism is the thalamic GATING relay (THAL = motif M4 gating/routing) failing. Both the canonical node cue ('stuck-closed=starvation') and the summary's 'court system overwhelmed / case backlogs' sit inside the single GATING_FAILURE archetype, whose definition spans both 'too little filtering -> flooding' (the backlog/overload reading) and 'gate stuck closed -> starvation' (the delay-as-denial reading). Downstream starvation of the legal system for functional adjudication is the dominant outcome named.
JUDICIAL_CRISIS.note: The summary also carries a legitimacy strand ('Judicial independence threatened by political appointment manipulation, funding pressure, or public legitimacy erosion'); that strand is an integrity concern and is NOT what drives the class. Classed on the gating/throughput mechanism the canonical node names.

CONSTITUTIONAL_VIOLATION.subtype: brake-fail -> rogue (executive overreach; loss of the stop/brake)
CONSTITUTIONAL_VIOLATION.law_text: canonical circuit vmPFC[Hypo]: "top-down inhibitory brake — brake-fail=rogue"; summary: "Executive overreach, legislative rights erosion, or judicial abdication undermines the constitutional framework"
CONSTITUTIONAL_VIOLATION.reasoning: The named mechanism is explicitly the loss of the top-down INHIBITORY BRAKE ('brake-fail=rogue'). Executive overreach is the constitutionally-restrained actor breaking free of its brake and releasing rogue activity — the exact DISINHIBITION_SYNDROME definition (loss of the stop/brake). Mirrors Finance CURRENCY_COLLAPSE's vmPFC brake-fail -> DISINHIBITION mapping.
CONSTITUTIONAL_VIOLATION.note: The summary phrase 'systematic breach of foundational legal principles' carries a legitimacy strand; the class is grounded on the named brake-fail dynamical mechanism, not the legitimacy framing. Distinct from REGULATORY_CAPTURE (same vmPFC cue) because here the brake is ABSENT/overridden, not captured.

MASS_INCARCERATION.subtype: runaway punitive/threat drive exceeding damping capacity
MASS_INCARCERATION.law_text: canonical circuit PAG[Hyper]: "defensive kill/lockdown — over-freeze"; authored BLA[Hyper]: "Criminal law threat detection hypersensitized — minor offenses trigger maximum punitive response"; authored CeA[Hyper]: "Law enforcement output maximized beyond public safety necessity"; summary: "Hypertrophied punitive response producing incarceration rates far beyond what public safety requires"
MASS_INCARCERATION.reasoning: Hypersensitized threat detection (BLA[Hyper]) plus maximized enforcement output (CeA[Hyper]) disproportionate to actual public-safety risk is recurrent runaway excitation exceeding insufficient inhibition = the SEIZURE archetype (no-brakes -> runaway). Structurally the closest analog to Finance MARKET_CRASH (BLA over-fear + capacity overwhelmed -> SEIZURE).
MASS_INCARCERATION.note: Straddles DISINHIBITION_SYNDROME — the authored rACC[Hypo] 'due process protections functionally eliminated' is a failed brake. Classed as SEIZURE on the 'hypertrophied response ... far beyond what safety requires' runaway outcome the summary names.

INTERNATIONAL_LAW_BREAKDOWN.subtype: brake-fail -> rogue unilateralism (loss of the stop/brake)
INTERNATIONAL_LAW_BREAKDOWN.law_text: canonical circuit vmPFC[Hypo]: "top-down inhibitory brake — brake-fail=rogue"; summary: "Great-power unilateralism, treaty withdrawal, and international court non-compliance undermine the rules-based order ... disputes between nations default to economic coercion and military force"; authored AG[Hypo]: "Integrative capacity of international law collapses as nations withdraw from multilateral frameworks, fragment into bilateral deals"
INTERNATIONAL_LAW_BREAKDOWN.reasoning: Great-power unilateralism is powerful actors no longer restrained by the top-down brake of international law, releasing rogue force/coercion = DISINHIBITION_SYNDROME (loss of the stop/brake), consistent with the canonical vmPFC brake-fail cue.
INTERNATIONAL_LAW_BREAKDOWN.note: Secondary strand: the authored primary node AG[Hypo] ('integrative capacity collapses ... fragment into bilateral deals') is a de-integration / DEAFFERENTATION flavor, and 'international court non-compliance / rules-based order' carries a legitimacy strand. Divergence between the disinhibition cue and the fragmentation/legitimacy strands is flagged, not resolved by guessing; classed on the dominant unilateralism/brake-fail mechanism.

REGULATORY_CAPTURE.reason: Issue text names an INTEGRITY / adversarial-capture mechanism with NO analog among the 9 Part XIV classes.
REGULATORY_CAPTURE.law_text: canonical circuit vmPFC[Hypo]: "top-down inhibitory brake — brake-fail=rogue"; authored dACC[Hypo]: "violations go undetected or unreported because regulators identify with industry rather than public"; summary: "Regulatory agencies co-opted by the industries they are meant to oversee ... watchdogs into lapdogs, and public interest is subordinated to private profit"
REGULATORY_CAPTURE.reasoning: Regulatory capture is not a brake that FAILED (dynamical disinhibition) but a brake whose ALLEGIANCE has been corrupted to actively serve the party it should restrain: 'co-opted', 'watchdogs into lapdogs', 'regulators identify with industry rather than public'. The 9 Part XIV classes are all dynamical-failure archetypes (excitation, inhibition, gating, clearance, synchrony, propagation); none expresses a captured / corrupted-allegiance / adversarial-integrity failure. Forcing it into DISINHIBITION (which its shared vmPFC cue superficially invites) would erase the distinction between an absent brake and a captured one. Marked UNMAPPED per discipline.
REGULATORY_CAPTURE.note: This is the KEY HETEROGENEITY FINDING for Law and the direct analog of Finance FRAUD_SCANDAL: an integrity/deception/capture archetype that the E/I-dynamics neuro-substrate taxonomy structurally cannot represent. Note it shares the vmPFC[Hypo] 'brake-fail=rogue' canonical cue with CONSTITUTIONAL_VIOLATION and INTERNATIONAL_LAW_BREAKDOWN (both mapped DISINHIBITION), but its authored/summary mechanism is capture, not brake-loss — same node cue, different failure family.

incomplete_circuit_diagnostic._test: Part XIV: does each issue's authored circuit contain a regulatory/inhibitory/feedback partner from the REGULATORY_NODES set in energy-neuro-substrate.js (vmPFC, dlPFC, OFC, STN, GP, HIPP, HYPO, dACC, CBLM)? Run against law.json _authored circuits, matching the JS validateIncompleteCircuit() behavior (uses _authored node list).
incomplete_circuit_diagnostic._verdict_summary: PASS (5/5). Every authored circuit includes at least one regulatory/feedback node; none is a bare excitatory driver without its brake. Same headline result as Finance (6/6) and Energy (6/6). NOTE: two issues (JUDICIAL_CRISIS, MASS_INCARCERATION) have CANONICAL single-node circuits (THAL, PAG) that are bare non-regulatory nodes and WOULD fail the test in isolation; the _authored multi-node circuits supply the regulatory partner.

JUDICIAL_CRISIS.observation: Canonical single-node circuit is THAL[Hypo] alone (gating relay, NOT in REGULATORY_NODES) -> would be INCOMPLETE_CIRCUIT if run canonical-only; _authored supplies OFC/dlPFC brakes.

CONSTITUTIONAL_VIOLATION.observation: Canonical single-node circuit is vmPFC[Hypo], itself a regulatory node -> complete even canonical-only.

REGULATORY_CAPTURE.observation: Circuit is complete (four regulatory nodes present), yet the issue is UNMAPPED in the failure-class map: a circuit can be structurally complete under the incomplete-circuit test and still express a failure archetype (capture/corrupted-allegiance) outside the 9-class taxonomy. The two diagnostics are independent — the same split Finance recorded for FRAUD_SCANDAL.

MASS_INCARCERATION.observation: Canonical single-node circuit is PAG[Hyper] alone (defensive kill/lockdown output, NOT in REGULATORY_NODES) -> would be INCOMPLETE_CIRCUIT if run canonical-only; _authored supplies dlPFC (and the rACC brake, though rACC is not in the REGULATORY_NODES set).

INTERNATIONAL_LAW_BREAKDOWN.observation: Canonical single-node circuit is vmPFC[Hypo], itself a regulatory node -> complete even canonical-only. _authored's sole REGULATORY_NODES member is dACC.

parameter_table.ratio_preservation_rule: When mapping any neural time constant to a domain equivalent, hold the RATIOS between constants fixed, not just individual values. The ~1000x gap between AP duration (~1 ms) and slow neuromodulatory/hormonal feedback (~seconds-minutes) is the 'fast signal vs slow modulation' invariant; the Law mapping must preserve an analogous fast-action / slow-governance separation, or the fractal is cosmetic, not structural.
